rows.headline: Reliance Industries posts strongest-ever quarter as revenue surges 28% to record ₹3.62 lakh crore
rows.hook: Record ₹29,550 crore profit in Q2 FY27
rows.summary: Reliance Industries reported a record quarterly net profit of ₹29,550 crore in Q2 FY27, marking a 34% increase year-on-year. Revenue surged 28% to over ₹3.6 lakh crore, driven by record oil-to-chemicals earnings and broad-based growth across all major business segments. This stellar performance reflects strong operational efficiency and robust demand across its diversified portfolio. As the largest company by market capitalization on the Indian bourses, this massive earnings beat directly impacts overall market sentiment and index performance.

rows.headline: Bengaluru office rents match Tokyo as Mumbai leasing hits record highs
rows.hook: Office rents and leasing surge in metros
rows.summary: Bengaluru saw an 11.5% annual increase in prime office rents during Q3 2026, reaching levels comparable to Tokyo. Simultaneously, Mumbai's commercial real estate market experienced a 33% surge in leasing transactions. Year-to-date leasing volumes in Mumbai have already surpassed the total recorded for the entire year of 2025. This data, provided by Knight Frank, highlights strong demand for premium office space in India's top financial and tech hubs.
rows.why_it_matters: Rising commercial rents signal strong corporate demand and economic activity.
rows.winners_losers: Commercial landlords gain / office tenants hurt

This segment remains a primary earnings driver for the conglomerate, reflecting strong operational performance. rows.headline: RBI announces state government securities auction worth Rs 29,900 crore
rows.hook: Rs 29,900 crore state debt auction scheduled
rows.summary: Twelve state governments have offered to sell stock through an auction to raise an aggregate amount of Rs 29,900 crore via the RBI's E-Kuber system. The auction is scheduled for November 3, 2026, with payments required by November 4, 2026. Individual investors can participate using the non-competitive bidding scheme through the RBI Retail Direct portal. These state government securities qualify for banks' Statutory Liquidity Ratio requirements.

rows.why_it_matters: Retail investors can bid for state government securities via RBI Retail Direct.

rows.hook: Loss narrows alongside a fresh dividend payout

Revenue from operations grew 29.84% to ₹125.44 crore, up from ₹96.61 crore. Additionally, the board announced an interim dividend of ₹5 per share, scheduled to be paid on or before November 26. rows.headline: RBI announces redemption price of Rs 14,167 per unit for SGB 2021-22 Series VII premature exit due on November 2, 2026
rows.hook: SGB premature exit priced at Rs 14,167
rows.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has set the premature redemption price for the Sovereign Gold Bond 2021-22 Series VII at Rs 14,167 per unit. This tranche, originally issued on November 2, 2021, becomes eligible for premature exit after five years on the interest payment date of November 2, 2026. The redemption price is calculated using the simple average of the closing price of 999 purity gold for the preceding three business days as published by IBJA. Retail investors holding this series can opt for premature redemption based on this notified rate.
rows.whats_next: Redemption processing date on November 02, 2026
rows.why_it_matters: SGB holders get a clear exit price ahead of November 2.

Retail investors should ensure they deal only with SEBI-registered entities to protect their capital from unauthorized financial advice. rows.why_it_matters: Verify advisor registration status before deploying funds.
